title: athyrium nitens
intro: Athyrium nitens, commonly known as the shining lady fern, is a type of vascular plant in the family Athyriaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium nitens are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
